gaps.sentence: Wake ___ — you'll be late for school!
The car ___ down on the motorway and had to be towed.
He puts his success down ___ hard work and a bit of luck.
gaps.explanation: put something down TO something = believe it has that cause.

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
She waited at the restaurant for an hour, but he had stood her ___ again.
gaps.explanation: 'Stand somebody up' = fail to keep an arranged meeting.

gaps.sentence: The negotiators refused to give ___ to the hijackers' demands.
gaps.explanation: give in (to) = stop arguing and accept; give up = quit.

gaps.sentence: Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.

gaps.sentence: It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.
